name: VC Trader AI Agent Place Order
description: Autonomously place a live order (with a mandatory stop-loss) while the account is set to act autonomously; otherwise the call does not go through and NOTHING is staged for approval (execution_status 'downgraded' + lock_reason). Requires account_id, symbol, side, qty, stop_loss, intended_price. Calls the propfirm_manager BFF as the workspace owner (PFM_AGENT_TOKEN) at /api/v1/workspaces/{ws}/live/orders/agent-place.
